name: First Response SLA by Priority
query:
SELECT
    priority AS "Priority:Data:100",
    COUNT(*) AS "SLA Tickets:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND first_response_at <= response_due_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "On Time:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN first_response_at > response_due_at
        OR (first_response_at IS NULL AND response_due_at < NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Missed:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NULL AND response_due_at >= NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Awaiting:Int:100",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND first_response_at <= response_due_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND first_response_at <= response_due_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + SUM(CASE WHEN first_response_at > response_due_at
            OR (first_response_at IS NULL AND response_due_at < NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1)
        AS "On-Time Rate:Percent:115",
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL
        THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, opened_at, first_response_at) / 3600.0
        ELSE NULL END), 1) AS "Avg First Response Hours:Float:160"
FROM `tabSupport Ticket`
WHERE
    response_due_at IS NOT NULL
    AND (IFNULL(%(from_date)s, '') = '' OR opened_at >= %(from_date)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(to_date)s, '') = '' OR opened_at < DATE_ADD(%(to_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
    AND (IFNULL(%(priority)s, '') = '' OR priority = %(priority)s)
GROUP BY priority
ORDER BY FIELD(priority, 'Urgent', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'), priority
